description: list_stories: list, browse, find or search the stories and games by genre or topic (sci-fi, space, mystery, horror, spies, westerns, history), by words in a title or pitch, by length or what's new; also describes one story when searched by its title. Lists the Plot Speaks stories and games that can be played by voice, three at a time with a one-line pitch each; the page argument gives the next three. Narrow it by a collection (Murder Mysteries, Greek Myths, Classic Detectives, Horror and Ghosts, Seasons, Holiday Specials, Bedtime, Dice Games, Road Trip, Read-Aloud Classics, Written by players), by length (max_minutes), by what's new (new: true), by topic (Science fiction and space, space adventures, classic science fiction, history, the Second World War, folklore and myth, German folklore, horror and ghosts and the other Browse topics on the site), by any words (search: a title, an author, a subject such as Mars or pirates), by kind (mysteries, adventures, choose-your-path stories, trivia, guessing games, game shows, dice games, word games, party and storytelling games, Table Talk, Story Time read-alouds, wind-downs, open worlds and campaigns) or, within mysteries, classic or dark. With group_by_category and no page it returns the whole catalogue under kind headings. An unknown kind or collection returns a message naming the valid ones. Call it silently: no "let me check", no "one moment".

audience.description: Narrow by audience: general, or the all-ages pieces. Omit for everything

collection.description: A collection, by name or id, loosely matched: greek-myths, classic-detectives, ghost-gothic, seasons, holidays, bedtime, dice, road-trip, classics, players. Examples: "Greek Myths", "detective stories".

genre.description: Within mysteries and adventures: murder-mystery (all murder mysteries), classic (murder mysteries that aren't dark), dark (dark murder mysteries) or adventure

group_by_category.description: True, with no page, for the whole list grouped under kind headings

kind.description: Only list this kind: mystery, adventure, branching (choose your path), trivia, guessing (guessing games), gameshow (game shows), dice (dice games), word (word games), party (party and storytelling), talk (Table Talk), story time (read-aloud classics), winddown (wind-downs), campaign (open worlds and D&D-style campaigns), or game (every one of the game kinds above except trivia and guessing)

max_minutes.description: Only pieces this many minutes long or shorter

new.description: True for what's new: the newest pieces first, with their What's New line

not_played.description: True to leave out what this player has already played (signed-in players only)

page.description: Which page of three to return, from 1; page 2 gives items 4 to 6 of the same filtered list. Each result states the page and total pages

search.description: Any words to look for in titles, pitches and authors, e.g. "space", "Jules Verne", "pirates". A topic name works here too

topic.description: A topic, by name or id, loosely matched: sci-fi (science fiction and space), space, classic science fiction, history, ancient world, world war two, folklore, German folklore, Greek myths, horror, classics, games, holidays

name: list_stories
